explanation: He called it Sonata quasi una fantasia. The nickname came from the critic Ludwig Rellstab, who in 1832, five years after Beethoven died, likened its first movement to moonlight on Lake Lucerne.

claims.text: Beethoven did not give the 'Moonlight' Sonata its nickname.
Beethoven titled the work 'Sonata quasi una fantasia'.
In 1832 the critic Ludwig Rellstab likened the sonata's first movement to moonlight on Lake Lucerne.
